title: lewisia pygmaea var. nevadensis
intro: Lewisia pygmaea var. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada Mountain Bitterroot, is a plant species within the Penthoraceae family. This perennial plant is native to the mountainous regions of the Great Basin in western North America, and its roots are valued for their medicinal properties. The health benefits of Lewisia pygmaea var. nevadensis include its ability to support immune function and potentially exhibit antimicrobial activity, although more research is needed to confirm its effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including alkaloids and glycosides, may contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
